items.titleZh: Ramp推出自己的AI模型路由器，名为Router
items.titleEn: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
items.summaryZh: TechCrunch AI 报道了人工智能的模型开发。消息来源要点：Ramp 推出了自己的 AI 模型路由服务，称为 Router，允许用户和公司通过 API 使用和切换各种大型语言模型。
items.summaryEn: TechCrunch AI reports a model development in AI. Key point from the source: Ramp has launched its own AI model routing service, dubbed Router, that lets users and companies use and switch between various large language models via an API.
items.overviewZh: TechCrunch AI 发布了有关“Ramp 推出自己的 AI 模型路由器，名为 Router”的最新更新。

items.summaryEn: OpenAI Blog reports a policy development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

items.titleZh: OpenAI 踩了刹车。现在怎么办？
items.titleEn: OpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能的行业发展。消息来源的关键点：随着 IPO 的临近、来自 Anthropic 的激烈竞争，以及中国和开放重量级竞争对手的紧追不舍，OpenAI 有充分的理由迅速采取行动。

items.titleZh: 新数据表明，OpenAI 正在赢得商业用户的青睐
items.titleEn: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
items.summaryZh: TechCrunch AI 报告了人工智能领域的业务发展。消息来源的要点是：随着每个实验室发布新模型，企业愿意来回波动，这种波动性应该会让两家公司的投资者对企业人工智能支出到底有多么“粘性”感到犹豫。
items.summaryEn: TechCrunch AI reports a business development in AI. Key point from the source: Businesses are willing to flop back and forth as each lab releases new models, volatility that should give both companies' investors pause about how "sticky" enterprise AI spending really is.
items.overviewZh: TechCrunch AI 发布了有关“新数据表明 OpenAI 正在商业用户中超越 Anthropic”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: TechCrunch AI published a new update about “OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates”.
